meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Civil Code No. 131 of 1948 and Commercial Code No. 17 of 1999, with Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation under Article 2 of the Constitution; modern commercial practice also draws on international model laws and English-language contract conventions)

Egypt–United Kingdom Promotion and Protection of Investments Agreement (1975, entered into force 1976)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as cumulatively amended, including beneficial-ownership information requirements) and its Executive Regulations; Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree, as amended); Law No. 94 of 2015 on Combating Terrorism; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT Rules; Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) rulebook applying to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs); GAFI circulars on UBO registers and economic substance; MENAFATF standards as adopted by Egypt.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry or chamber of commerce in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (clearance certificate evidencing legal existence, solvency, and absence of disqualifying filings)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry, tax authority, or equivalent supervisory body in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the corporate shareholder approving the establishment of the Egyptian LLC, capital subscription, and appointment of directors and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the corporate shareholder, duly notarized in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof-of-identity documents for all Ultimate Beneficial Owners, proposed managers, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds evidence and bank reference letters for the subscribed capital contributions
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate banking institution of the shareholder

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based enhanced due diligence screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, UK/EU restrictive measures, Interpol notices where relevant, and Egypt's national terrorist entities list maintained under Law No. 94 of 2015; mandatory PEP identification using reputable commercial databases and official registries, with enhanced monitoring for politically exposed persons and family/close-associate relationships; all screening results must be documented in the client risk file and retained for the statutory AML record-keeping period.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Investor One-Stop-Shop via the electronic 'Sherkaty' registration portal of the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Cairo; official reference portal: https://www.gafi.gov.eg
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be formulated in Arabic and comply with the naming rules under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and the Commercial Registry Regulations; a Latin-script transliteration is permissible for international banking and contract documentation but must constitute a faithful phonetic rendering of the registered Arabic name and must not conflict with the Arabic version in statutory filings; the name must be descriptive of the permitted object, non-misleading, consistent with public order, and sufficiently distinguishable from all names already registered in the Commercial Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banking (requires prior Central Bank of Egypt approval)
Insurance (requires prior Financial Regulatory Authority approval)
Securities / Portfolio / Financial Services (requires prior Financial Regulatory Authority approval)
Petroleum / Oil / Gas (requires prior Ministry of Petroleum license and clearance)
Government / Ministry / State / Public Authority (misleading and generally prohibited)
Arab / Egyptian / Mist (sensitive national tokens requiring GAFI committee approval where used in a corporate name)
Central / National / International (restricted and subject to proof of scope and sector licensing)
Islamic / Sharia (restricted and subject to religious and registration scrutiny)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection notice, the applicant may (i) submit a written administrative objection to GAFI's Name Clearance Committee within 15 working days of the rejection, attaching evidence of distinctiveness, trademark registrations, and prior ministerial approvals for sensitive tokens; or (ii) immediately file a revised name reservation request through the Sherkaty portal at no additional fee; where the administrative objection is denied, the applicant may initiate judicial review before the Egyptian Council of State (Administrative Court) within 60 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the statutory head office. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical registered address in Egypt where statutory books, the UBO register, corporate records, and service-of-process facilities are maintained; a virtual or shared administrative address may be used only for auxiliary correspondence and does not satisfy the head-office requirement for an LLC engaged in construction and EPC works.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. Estimated probability of approximately 20% for an unannounced on-site verification visit within the first 12 months after registration for a standard low-risk entity; probability increases materially if UBO documentation is incomplete, commercial substance indicators are weak, or screening events generate AML/CFT risk flags.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 159 of 1981 (Egyptian Companies Law), as amended by Law No. 5 of 2015, particularly the LLC provisions (Arts. 1-117), read with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and Presidential Decree No. 2310 of 2017 (Executive Regulations); commercial registration governed by Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), One-Stop Shop (OSS), in coordination with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation application accompanied by the notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Ta'sis) and GAFI's standard incorporation form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Law 159/1981; the Articles freely fix the share capital, but 100% of the subscribed nominal capital must be fully paid at formation into a temporary blocked account at a licensed Egyptian bank, released after GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation; up to 100% non-resident ownership is permitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscribers identified in the Articles of Association hereby subscribe for the entire issued share capital, and the Managers are directed to open a temporary blocked bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank and deposit the subscribed capital. (2) The registered office is established at the address in Article 4 of the Articles, and the General Manager is authorized to execute lease agreements for that premises. (3) The following persons are appointed as General Manager, Commercial Manager, and Corporate Secretary. (4) The Corporate Secretary is authorized to file all statutory forms with GAFI, the Commercial Registry, the Tax Authority, and the Social Insurance Authority and to take all ancillary acts to obtain the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) - Investor Services Center; online reservation via GAFI's electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed name-reservation request through GAFI's OSS or e-portal with three alternative names in Latin and transliterated Arabic. GAFI screens the proposed names against Law 159/1981, the Civil Code, and registered trademark lists. Upon approval, a Name Reservation Certificate valid for 60 days is issued, which the applicant must reference in the Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: GAFI name-reservation application form
Three proposed alternative company names (Arabic/English)
Copy of each subscriber's passport or national ID
Notarized power of attorney if any subscriber is a corporate entity
Resolution of the founding entity authorizing incorporation (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or non-compliance, file revised name alternatives online within 5 working days; a written appeal may be addressed to GAFI's Legal Affairs Department for a final administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Temporary Capital Deposit and Bank Blockage Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) - corporate accounts division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate bank account in the company's name with the licensed bank, deposit the full subscribed paid-up capital, and obtain a blockage/credit certificate evidencing the deposit. The bank performs KYC and source-of-funds verification; the certificate is submitted to GAFI as proof of payment of share capital.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate issued by GAFI
Draft Articles of Association showing share capital and subscriber list
Bank account opening and KYC documentation for all shareholders
Passport copies of the authorised signatories
Source-of-funds declaration for the subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries KYC forms for foreign shareholders, submit a fully notarized and legalized power of attorney and a bank reference letter; alternatively, transfer the account to another licensed bank on GAFI's approved list without losing the reservation certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice - Notary Public Office (Companies Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the Arabic Articles of Association signed by all subscribers, pay the stamp duties, and execute the instrument before the competent Notary Public. The notary authenticates the identities and signatures of the subscribers or their attorneys and issues a notarized minute to be lodged with the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Association in Arabic (minimum 3 counterparts)
GAFI name reservation certificate
Bank blockage certificate and capital deposit proof
Passports or national IDs of all subscribing individuals
Notarized power of attorney for any founder acting through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to the share allocation, registered office clause, or stamp denomination, amend the relevant clause and resubmit for execution the same day; full re-execution is required within 3 working days to preserve the capital blockage certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the complete incorporation file with GAFI OSS: notarized Articles of Association, bank blockage certificate, name reservation certificate, and lease of the registered office. Pay the official state filing fees, and GAFI registers the company, issues the Certificate of Incorporation, and automatically notifies the Commercial Registry and tax databases.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (notarial minute)
GAFI name reservation certificate
Bank blockage certificate and proof of paid-up capital transfer
Lease contract or proof of title for the registered office
GAFI incorporation application form and officer/signatory data sheets
Passport copies and powers of attorney of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query, respond in writing within the 30-day statutory cure period; if the file is denied, correct the flagged clause and re-submit with the GAFI objection letter and corrected documents, or escalate to the GAFI Grievance Committee for review within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Registration and Tax Card/VAT Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificate of Incorporation to the Commercial Registry to obtain the commercial registration extract and unified economic number. Concurrently apply to the ETA for the corporate tax card and register for VAT if the taxable supply threshold is met. These registrations enable the company to issue tax invoices and bid for desalination EPC contracts.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial registry application forms (Forms 12/13)
Board resolution appointing the General Manager and Secretary
Lease contract of the registered office
Tax card application and VAT registration forms
Copy of the notarized Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry or ETA issues a document-mismatch query, reconcile the spelling of names and tax ID numbers, resubmit stamped correction sheets, and pay any administrative re-registration fee; the tax card can be expedited by filing Form 1/2 with the ETA liaison office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - local authority office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer at the competent NOSI office within 30 days from the commercial registration date, using Form 1 (establishment data) and Form 2 (workforce and wage list). Obtain the social insurance establishment number which must be shown on all payroll and project-site documentation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and commercial registration extract
Form 1 establishment registration return
Form 2 list of insured workers and wage declarations
Manager and employee identification documents
Workplace address and scale-of-economic activity documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI assesses a late-filing surcharge, pay the nominal penalty under the Social Insurance Law and submit the delayed Form 1 with a covering explanation letter; an inspection date is rescheduled upon proof of payment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) of Egypt - Industrial Licensing Center
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Unified Industrial Operating License under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 and Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 1032 of 2018)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) under Law No. 4 of 1994 (Environment Law)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report required for seawater desalination plants above 10,000 m3/day including marine intake and brine outfall works; Category B registration and scoping apply to smaller pilot facilities; EEAA Environmental Approval is a precondition for construction and operating permits.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Brine discharge to the marine environment must meet EEAA permit thresholds: pH 6-9, BOD5 not exceeding 60 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 80 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 15 mg/L, total residual chlorine not exceeding 0.2 mg/L, maximum discharge temperature rise of 3 degrees Celsius above ambient receiving water, and strict conditioning of antiscalants and coagulants; air emissions for auxiliary boilers/gensets and VOC fugitive releases must comply with EEAA Guideline No. 6 of 2010 and occupational exposure limits under Ministerial Decree No. 211 of 2003; spent membranes, cartridge filters, and cleaning chemicals are managed as hazardous industrial waste under Law 4/1994 rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Directorate (Ministry of Interior) fire-safety certificate under Law No. 441 of 1959 covering hydrant network, fire-fighting pumps, gas detection, and evacuation plans; structural-load and building-license approvals under Law No. 106 of 1976; Ministry of Manpower occupational safety and health clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 including establishment registration, OHS committee formation, and pre-operational site inspection.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance. Official e-services portals: ETA Tax Portal (https://www.eta.gov.eg), e-Invoice/e-Receipt platform (https://www.invoice.mis.gov.eg), and unified tax filing portal (https://www.tax.gov.eg).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a desalination EPC LLC: (1) incorporate the LLC through the General Authority for Investment & Free Zones (GAFI) or the local Commercial Registry and obtain the Commercial Registration number; (2) apply to the competent ETA branch for the Tax Card (Egyptian Tax Identification Number), submitting incorporation certificate, Memorandum of Association, lease/office agreement, and board resolution; (3) register for VAT and obtain a separate VAT certificate prior to first taxable supply or import; (4) if acting through an Egyptian branch, register the branch as a Permanent Establishment of the non-resident entity for Corporate Income Tax; (5) obtain ETA electronic invoice transmitter credentials and integrate the ERP with the ETA e-invoicing API.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: an Egyptian LLC is an opaque corporate taxpayer subject to Corporate Income Tax under Law No. 91 of 2005. Residents are taxed on worldwide income; non-resident LLCs and branches are taxed only on Egypt-source income (territorial limitation). No pass-through election is available to the LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not apply a US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. The LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level. Available statutory mechanisms include: (i) group tax consolidation for wholly-owned resident companies meeting the Law 91/2005 conditions; (ii) election among fiscal depreciation methods within statutory ceilings; (iii) voluntary VAT registration at EGP 100,000 annual turnover; and (iv) election to apply transfer pricing comparable methods and advanced pricing arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016; standard rate 14% with a 5% reduced rate for selected goods/services. Prior sales tax regime abolished.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration for a supplier of taxable goods or services whose annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000. Voluntary registration is permitted from EGP 100,000. Importers of goods into Egypt must register regardless of turnover; non-resident suppliers may be subject to recipient accounting / reverse charge obligations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates real-time e-invoicing and e-receipt clearance through the ETA central system. Registered taxpayers must transmit certified B2B invoices via the ETA API in the approved JSON/XML schema; each invoice receives a unique compliance code and QR signature after ETA validation. B2C retail transactions must use the e-receipt system. The same fiscal data must be integrated with ERP or middleware using ETA digital signature credentials. Failure to clear invoices in real time may block transactions and attract penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAT-registered exporter may apply 0% VAT where: (i) goods are physically exported from Egypt to a non-resident buyer within the statutory period and the Customs Export Declaration shows foreign destination; (ii) services are supplied to a non-resident person and are effectively used or consumed outside Egypt, including offshore seawater desalination engineering services; and (iii) export proceeds are received in freely convertible foreign currency. Domestic desalination construction works in Egypt remain taxable at 14%; only the exported portion qualifies for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan Shika) processed through the Al-Nafeza single window
Bill of Lading / airway bill evidencing goods left Egypt
Commercial invoice and underlying EPC/desalination contract
Certificate of origin (if required by buyer or for preferential tariff claims)
ETA VAT export invoice with the 0% rate code
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank foreign-exchange statement confirming receipt of export proceeds
Export manifest and shipping instructions issued by the vessel/operator
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA cross-matches export zero-rating claims with Customs export declarations, e-invoice data, and Central Bank of Egypt foreign-exchange remittance records. If documentation is incomplete, the export is recharacterized as a taxable domestic supply and VAT is assessed at 14%, together with late-payment interest and administrative fines. Knowingly issuing a false zero-rated invoice or submitting forged export documents is a VAT fraud offense punishable by a penal fine of not less than EGP 50,000, potential imprisonment, and an additional penalty of at least 100% of the tax evaded. Retained refunds are clawed back with legal surcharge; the statute of limitation for audit is generally five years, extended in cases of fraud or concealment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Al-Bank Al-Markazi Al-Masry, the sole supervisory and regulatory authority for banking and the exchange market under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law), exercising licensing, commercial-bank supervision, AML/CFT rulemaking, and balance-of-payments statistics reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed-floating exchange-rate regime. Current-account transactions (imports of goods/services, interest, and repatriation of duly audited profits) are convertible through the interbank market upon presentation of genuine underlying documents, subject to US-dollar liquidity allocation during stressed periods. Capital-account flows are legal but require CBE registration and, where applicable, GAFI (General Authority for Investment) clearance under Foreign Investment Law No. 72 of 2017. Profit remittance hurdles are primarily documentary: audited financial statements, valid tax clearance certification, board resolution authorizing distribution, and CBE purpose-code verification (code 8810 for profit remittances); banks may impose queueing during scarcity episodes. The desalination EPC company should contract for settlement in USD to reduce EGP conversion risk and maintain full traceability of each inflow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All proceeds from export/sale of goods or services must be credited to an account in an Egypt-licensed bank within the tenor of the documentary credit or sale contract, and in any event no later than 180 days from issuance of the bill of lading or service-completion certificate, with extension only by CBE approval. No mandatory conversion to EGP is presently in force after the November-2016 float and the 2024 liberalization; 100% of proceeds must nonetheless enter the Egyptian banking system (100% surrender into a domestic foreign-currency account), after which the exporter may retain the currency or convert at interbank rates. Netting, offshore retention, or settlement through a non-Egyptian clearing hub is prohibited for third-party export receivables.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Project-Financing Escrow Account; Operational Account (USD and EGP)
Capital Escrow Account; Operational Account (USD and EGP)
Operational Account; USD Correspondent Clearing and Trade-Settlement Account
Operational Account; Import LC and EPC Supply-Chain Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Offshore digital EMIs and multi-currency wallets (for example Revolut Business, Wise Business, Payoneer) are not licensed or passported into Egypt and cannot serve as the primary treasury or settlement rail for the Egyptian LLC. Legal constraints arise from the CBE's exclusive licensing of banks under Law No. 194 of 2020, the Payment Systems Law No. 18 of 2019, and CBE AML/CFT rules that require customer funds and FX conversion to be conducted within licensed Egyptian institutions. Foreign EMI wallets may be used only as an ancillary collection bridge for incidental pre-export or international R&D recoveries; such funds must be repatriated onward to a CBE-licensed bank file. Relying on any offshore EMI as an EPC payment trunk will create adverse AML/KYC inference and will not be accepted for the project escrow or customs-driven settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence at a licensed bank branch is mandatory for the authorized signatories and for verification of each beneficial owner with 10% or more ownership. CBE AML rules (pursuant to AML Law No. 80 of 2002 and CBE's KYC Guidelines) do not permit fully remote opening; video-identification is accepted in limited cases only for Egyptian-resident natural persons, never for non-resident directors. Where foreign directors cannot travel, the bank will accept a notarized power of attorney executed before an Egyptian consulate, plus an Egyptian-resident POA-holder with directorial or managerial authority to appear in person and sign the account mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-transparent ultimate beneficial-ownership chain, including foreign parent entities in layered offshore holding jurisdictions without economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation for each corporate layer; registers of directors and members; notarized resolutions of the board and shareholders; complete corporate-organizational chart tracing control to natural persons; CBE Beneficial-Owner Declaration (Form BO-1); apostilled or consular-legalized confirmatory affidavits from the foreign parent; lease contracts, payroll and license evidence proving economic substance in each intermediate jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection sourced from mixed or third-party contributors inconsistent with the LLC's capital plan
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed shareholders' loan or capital-call agreement; board minutes approving the funding round; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declarations from each contributor; bank reference letters and statements of the remitting account; consolidated corporate due-diligence bundle demonstrating legal provenance of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party EPC subcontracting through high-transit jurisdictions with opaque value-chain and pricing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master EPC and subcontract agreements with milestone schedules and liquidated damages; commercial invoices; bills of lading and airway bills; marine insurance certificates; arm's-length transfer-pricing memorandum; independent counterparty KYC pack; project-completion certificates from comparable desalination or water-plant references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear provenance of the desalination project award and public-sector settlement currency expectations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Project award letter and executed EPC contract with the relevant Egyptian or regional counterparty; water-purchase or power-purchase agreement; SCZONE or Ministry-level project approval; CBE inward-declaration receipt; written confirmation of settlement currency and recognized liquidity priority for the contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or restricted-party matches against equipment suppliers, transporters or beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC, OFSI and EU Consolidated List screening reports for all counterparties and beneficial owners; World-Check or Dow Jones risk-intelligence reports; signed end-user and end-use certificates for each machinery import; freight-forwarder and customs-agent AML credentials; sworn board certificate confirming no restricted-party nexus in the supply chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency among commercial-registry, GAFI investment records, tax registration and CBE FX declarations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified commercial-registry extract; valid tax card and tax-clearance certificate; notarized articles of association and all amendments; CBE inward-capital declaration; GAFI investment certificate with national project classification; unified corporate data pack harmonizing all register entries.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire-transfer protocol: inbound equity capital must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code 7210 ('Direct investment in the capital of an Egyptian company'), routed from the foreign parent's home account through its correspondent to the designated CBE-licensed account bank, and credited to the Capital Escrow Account. The receiving bank issues a certified inward-transfer certificate (I.N. Form) for CBE balance-of-payments registration, and must retain evidence linking the wire to the LLC: the notarized capital contribution resolution, the LLC's commercial-registry extract, its tax card, and audited financials. Where funding is a shareholder loan, purpose code 7220 ('Intercompany lending') applies and requires the signed loan agreement, board approval, and amortization schedule. Funds must derive directly from the shareholder's own account; third-party pass-through is rejected unless it represents a licensed pre-payment of the desalination project. USD-to-EGP conversion for local expenditures must occur in the interbank market, evidenced by the bank's conversion ticket.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational payments (consulting fees, insurance, head-office recharges below CBE threshold) are cleared by SWIFT MT103 (serial or cover) via the bank's correspondent network. High-value capital procurement for the desalination plant - membranes, pressure vessels, high-pressure pumps, thermal evaporators, switchgear and SCADA equipment - must be settled through irrevocable commercial letters of credit (MT700) opened by the Egyptian bank at sight or up to 180-day usance, with presentation of full shipping sets (commercial invoice, bill of lading, inspection certificate, packing list) through the advising/confirming bank. USD clearing is settled via CHIPS/Fedwire through New York correspondents; EUR-denominated options are settled over TARGET2 where suppliers are European. Domestic large EGP disbursements are executed through the Egyptian interbank RTGS. Every foreign-currency payment must be supported by the underlying EPC contract invoice and entered in the CBE's quarterly balance-of-payments reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP spot transactions transacted in the CBE interbank market, serving as the benchmark conversion rail for project cash inflows and outflows
Deliverable USD/EGP outright forward contracts written by CBE-licensed banks, maximum 365 days, on proven underlying EPC receivable or payable exposure with maturity-matched cash-flow schedules

FX swaps (USD/EGP) combining spot and forward legs for liquidity matching of the 6-month EPC working-capital cycle, with no speculative overlay; each swap must reference a documented project cost or receipt event

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) under a documented ISDA/CSA with a CBE-licensed or OECD-regulated counterparty used to neutralize the mismatch between USD-denominated project financing and EGP-denominated domestic construction costs

Currency options covering contingency exposure may be permissible where offered by a licensed bank with the option premium capitalized into the project treasury; speculative positions and positive-carry-only strategies beyond the underlying net exposure are prohibited under CBE Law No. 194 of 2020

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax annual return (entity-level tax on net income) including audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - corporate tax assessment office and e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end; calendar-year LLCs file by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% per month (maximum 50%) on assessed tax; fixed non-filing fine of EGP 1,000-5,000; continued non-compliance results in ETA suspension of tax card and GAFI administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements, auditor's report, and shareholders' approval minutes (AGM package)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Control Department and Commercial Registry file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit and AGM approval within 6 months of fiscal year-end (by 30 June for calendar-year LLCs); statutory deposit with GAFI within 30 days after AGM
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Companies Law No. 159/1981 fines of EGP 2,000-10,000; two consecutive default years without filing exposes the LLC to GAFI administrative strike-off and manager disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual payroll tax aggregation and reconciliation schedule (PAYE year-end statement for all employees)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - payroll and salaries tax unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January following the tax year (annual reconciliation after mandatory monthly PAYE remittances)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 2% per month on unreconciled withheld amounts; criminal fine up to EGP 10,000 for wilful non-submission; ETA may attach bank accounts and request GAFI strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and ownership-structure confirmation declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March, and within 30 days of any share transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002 fines up to EGP 100,000; unrecorded quota transfers are ineffective against third parties; repeated default triggers commercial register strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registration certificate maintenance and quinquennial renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop / Commercial Registry Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual maintenance confirmation each January; full renewal at the 5th anniversary of the entry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal fine of about EGP 100 per day per record; operating without a valid commercial registration is a criminal offence and leads to automatic administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual social insurance wage settlement and year-end contribution reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March following the contribution year; monthly contribution declarations remain due by the 15th of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-contribution surcharge of 2% per month; employer default may trigger criminal prosecution, provisional seizure of assets, and suspension of the company's trade file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual environmental self-monitoring report and desalination discharge compliance statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of fiscal year-end (by 1 March for calendar-year facilities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Environmental Law No. 4/1994 (as amended by Law 9/2009) administrative fines up to EGP 100,000; permit suspension or plant shutdown order for material non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue or size threshold: every Egyptian LLC must appoint at least one independent auditor registered in the Accountants and Auditors Registry (under Law No. 159/1981); a full statutory audit is mandatory even for single-shareholder and construction-contract special-purpose vehicles.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by ministerial decree (converged with IFRS); EAS for Small and Medium Enterprises applies to eligible small entities; long-term desalination EPC contracts are recognised in accordance with EAS 21 Revenue from Contracts with Customers (equivalent to IFRS 15).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The statutory members' register must record every quota or share transfer before the transfer is effective against third parties; annual UBO confirmation is filed with GAFI every March and re-certifies the register after any ownership movements. The majority shareholder or manager must also update UBO data within 30 days of any change and re-verify beneficial ownership before each AGM.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Transfers and UBO data

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 4,500 per year (EAS audit of an EPC-type LLC with treasury and escrow accounts)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly established companies in certain investment areas under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 may qualify for a 50% deduction of capital investment costs for up to five years; a 0% headline rate is available only to licensed Free Zone companies. No desalination-specific sectoral reduction is codified, but construction of desalination plants in the Suez Canal Economic Zone may obtain investment incentives if certified.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Corporate Income Tax Return Form No. 2 (IT-2) — submitted electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority's E-Tax Portal (https://egypttax.gov.eg).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months of the fiscal year-end; the fiscal year must match the legal accounting period. The Egyptian Tax Authority may grant limited extensions for consolidated groups only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Return Type and Legal Identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indicates normal filing, amendment or dormant status; requires Tax Card number and Commercial Registration number of the LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The company must file under the local LLC Tax Card; a non-resident shareholder has no separate filing line and is represented by the Egyptian director or attorney via power of attorney.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end dates of the accounting period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned LLCs must align this period with the bookkeeping period; year-end close must be documented in the Egyptian accounting records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All construction, EPC, and engineering receipts including progress billings, change orders, and any in-kind considerations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Revenues arising from a desalination project performed in Egypt are Egyptian-source and must be fully declared, even if invoiced to a foreign parent or funded through an offshore escrow account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 11 – Cost of Goods Sold and Direct Costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of desalination construction: materials, subcontracted works, labour, site overheads, and depreciation of construction equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subcontractor payments to non-resident related parties must be supported by arm's-length certificates and Egyptian TP disclosure forms; otherwise deductions may be denied.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, financing costs, insurance, and admissible provisions; carries forward losses are claimed here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions for group management fees, royalties, and interest require adequate documentation and, for offshore payments, proper advance withholding tax settlement under Law 91/2005.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after statutory adjustments, including depreciation recapture and non-deductible provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Egyptian-source profit on the desalination EPC is taxable at the standard 22.5% rate; no offshore grouping may reduce this amount without an active PE analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax rate applied to Box 41.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The rate is 22.5% unless the company is established in a Free Zone or enjoys a specific investment incentive, in which case the certification number must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross corporate tax liability after applying the rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount must be paid in Egyptian pounds through the E-Tax system; deferred payment triggers monetary surcharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 44 – Advance Payments and Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly estimated tax advances and any foreign tax credit deducted from gross tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned LLC may claim treaty credits only if the actual beneficiary provides necessary tax residence evidence; the pre-filling of the credit line does not relieve the payer from withholding obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 45 – Net Payment Due or Refund Claim
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final settlement after credits; if negative, the refund claim may be set off against future taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot directly refund Egyptian taxes; refunds may only be issued to the LLC bank account registered with the Egyptian Tax Authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an additional monthly tax of 2% of the tax due, capped at 25% of total tax, plus interest at 10% per annum on the defaulted amount under Law 91/2005. Failure to comply with a request to file after formal notice may lead to discretionary assessment and criminal sanctions, including a fine equivalent to 20% of the evaded tax and possible imprisonment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Estimated Corporate Tax Return Form (Form No. 1Q) — filed via the same Egyptian Tax Authority E-Tax Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the end of each fiscal quarter (31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December). The final annual return reconciled in Form No. 2 fully substitutes and settles all four advances.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Prior Fiscal Year Tax Base
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The assessable base from the most recent annual return, used to compute the minimum quarterly prepayment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a newly-created non-resident-owned LLC, the first quarterly advance may be based on projected cash-flow estimates, as certified by the local financial director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Estimated Current Year Taxable Profit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Projected profit for the current financial year based on the percentage of completion of the desalination contract.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The projection must be conservative and traceable to actual engineering work, materials supply and site progress; unrealistically minimal estimates trigger audit scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The quarter's share of estimated tax, net of any previous advance, credited into the government treasury.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments must be made from the LLC's Egyptian bank account; payments from any offshore escrow account are treated as unfulfilled tax obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay quarterly advances results in interest at 10% per annum on the unpaid balance and a monthly surcharge of 2% of the unpaid advance, capped at 25% of the annual total tax due. Continued neglect can suspend the tax card and block imports or customs release for construction equipment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on the net distributable profit paid to shareholders, applicable equally to residents and non-residents under Law 91/2005. Distributions from Free Zone companies may be exempt if the Free Zone certificate and the source of the distributed profits are entirely non-Egyptian.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its country of residence and submit it, together with Form 45 and the respective DTA application form, to the Egyptian payer before the distribution date. The payer may only apply the reduced treaty rate after the Egyptian Tax Authority issues a written approval or formal pre-confirmation in the electronic system; retrospective refund claims are subject to strict statute of limitation review. For desalination EPC works, extension of a foreign contractor's site operations beyond the applicable threshold months may constitute a permanent establishment and override treaty dividend benefits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties paid to non-residents is 20% of the gross amount; interest paid to foreign creditors is also subject to a 20% WHT subject to treaty reductions. Egypt's DTAs commonly reduce royalty and interest WHT to 10–15% for beneficial owners; however, a TRC and proof of beneficial ownership are mandatory. Interest paid to a foreign bank on project debt guaranteed by the Egyptian government may enjoy an exemption under Law 91/2005, subject to pre-approval.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation are required where total controlled transactions with related parties exceed EGP 15 million in a single fiscal year. The Master File is mandatory where the ultimate parent's consolidated group turnover is EGP 200 million or more. The TP disclosure form (Form 2 – Transfer Pricing Declaration) must be filed with the annual return whenever related-party transactions exceed EGP 10 million.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not apply a separate Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) statute in the style of Gulf jurisdictions; however, under Investment Law and the General Anti-Abuse Rule of Article 30 of Law 91/2005, a company claiming tax incentives or treaty relief must maintain genuine decision-making management, qualified employees, operational premises, accounting records, and active bank accounts within Egypt. A desalination LLC used as a dormant shell while a foreign parent negotiates and performs the EPC contract within Egypt will cause the foreign parent to be treated as having a permanent establishment and the shell to be disregarded for tax purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of EPC progress billings, unrecorded change-order payments, or use of an offshore escrow device to channel desalination milestone payments without recognition in the Egyptian books, accompanied by destruction or concealment of invoices and accounting ledgers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A fine of at least 20% of the tax evaded and, in aggravated circumstances, fines up to triple the evaded tax, plus the monthly 2% delayed-payment surcharge capped at 25%. Criminal conviction under Law 91/2005 Article 133 carries imprisonment from six months to five years and joint liability of all executive directors who knowingly signed or directed the fraudulent return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally responsible for the full amount of under-declared tax, the fine and criminal penalties. Egyptian courts regularly impose asset attachment, travel bans, and up to five years' imprisonment on directors who approved false revenue recognition or instructed concealment of project receipts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Artificial Entity Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining an Egyptian LLC with no employees, no physical premises, no local communication line and no substantive project participation, while that LLC is placed interposed between the non-resident contractor and the Egyptian purchaser of desalination works solely to obtain investment incentives or treaty benefits and to avoid Egyptian-source income taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The artificial entity is disregarded, all revenue is re-characterized as attributable to a permanent establishment of the foreign principal, and the full 22.5% corporate tax is imposed on the relevant EPC profit, together with default interest and administrative penalties of up to 25% of the tax due.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The managing director who authorized the shell arrangement and signed the intercompany agreements is exposed to recovery of the full attributed tax under a veil-piercing theory. The court may order confiscation of personal assets, restrict exit through travel bans, and impose a period of imprisonment if the scheme is deemed a fraudulent misrepresentation to the Egyptian Tax Authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring desalination project payments, project-financing escrow withdrawals, or SWIFT wire receipts into nominee bank accounts or unrelated third-party accounts without recording them in the LLC's accounting system, thereby breaching AML record-keeping and reporting obligations under Law 80/2002 and the Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Regulations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate freezing of the LLC's bank accounts and revocation of the tax card; additional monetary penalties up to EGP 150,000 and criminal fines up to five times the laundered sum. The Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit automatically receives the annual tax return and any unusual transaction report, initiating administrative and criminal procedures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face individual criminal prosecution if they authorize cross-border withdrawals or escrow disbursements without adequate know-your-counterparty and beneficial-ownership due diligence. Conviction may lead to imprisonment for up to two years, a personal fine, and an order to restore all laundered funds to the State, effectively removing the limitation of liability otherwise enjoyed by LLC shareholders.
